questions.prompt: Match the database word to its meaning.
pairs: A set of records of one kind, like customers
A question you ask the database
questions.explanation: Tables hold rows, and rows have a value for each column.
`*` means all columns. With no WHERE or LIMIT, you get every row.

questions.prompt: Complete the query to show only names: `SELECT ____ FROM customers;`
questions.explanation: List the columns you want after SELECT.

questions.prompt: Put the parts of this query in the right order.
questions.explanation: SELECT (which columns), FROM (which table), then LIMIT (how many rows).

questions.prompt: This query gives a syntax error. Which line?
questions.explanation: Line 2 has a comma after the **last** column. SQL then expects another column name and finds `FROM` instead.
